result.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.0706(c) (Ord. O-21647 N.S.); see also id. § 98.0706(b)(1)(B)(i)
result.citation_basis: § 98.0706(c) and § 98.0706(b)(1)(B)(i): D073; Ord. O-21647 N.S.: D073 (history note stating § 98.0706 was added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S., with no later amendment shown)
result.official_quote: (i) Unless section 98.0706(c)(1)(A)(ii) applies, the direct payment to the tenant shall be in an amount equal to two months of actual rent under the tenant’s lease in effect at the date of the notice. (ii) If the tenant is a senior or disabled, the direct payment to the tenant shall be in an amount equal to three months of actual rent under the tenant’s lease in effect at the date of the notice.
result.note: Kept the § 98.0706(c) pinpoint and Ord. O-21647 N.S., and added a see-also cite to § 98.0706(b)(1)(B)(i), which holds the card's 15-day direct-payment rule.
